mapper.insert: insert into kb_llm_cache (cache_key, cache_type, response, model_code, hit_count, create_time) values (#{cacheKey}, #{cacheType}, #{response}, #{modelCode}, 0, now()) on conflict (cache_key) do nothing
mapper.update: update kb_llm_cache set hit_count = hit_count + 1 where cache_key = #{cacheKey}
